answer: The pulse of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Each submission hangs on the whisper of a task receipt, and the terrace is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, published publicly on failure, rewards vest against future work. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
